label: AQA-style practice (Revision-authored, not an AQA question)

question.context: Revision-authored AQA-style practice. Willow Bakehouse sells boxed brownies to local cafés.
question.stem: Willow Bakehouse charges cafés £18.00 for each boxed brownie. The variable cost is £11.50 per boxed brownie. Calculate the contribution per unit.

option_rationale: A is correct because contribution per unit = selling price per unit − variable cost per unit = £18.00 − £11.50 = £6.50.
B is incorrect because £11.50 is the variable cost per unit, not the contribution.
C is incorrect because £18.00 is the selling price per unit, not the contribution.
D is incorrect because it adds the selling price and variable cost instead of subtracting the variable cost from the selling price.
